items.headline: Pinterest stock takes a hit on cautious outlook for future revenue growth.
items.teaser: Pinterest shares fell sharply after the company reported its second-quarter earnings, despite beating expectations on revenue and profit,…
items.story:
Pinterest shares fell sharply after the company reported its second-quarter earnings, despite beating expectations on revenue and profit, as its sales guidance for the current quarter was seen as lukewarm by investors. The social media platform, which allows users to save and share images and videos, reported earnings per share of $0.11, exceeding the consensus estimate of $0.06. Revenue for the quarter rose to $744 million, also surpassing expectations of $714 million. The company's user base continued to grow, with monthly active users increasing by 9% year-over-year.

The earnings report is significant as it provides insight into the company's ability to monetize its user base and compete with other social media platforms. Pinterest has been investing heavily in its advertising business, and the company's revenue growth is seen as a key indicator of its success in this area. The company's user base is also an important factor, as it provides a large audience for advertisers to reach. Pinterest's focus on visual discovery and planning has made it a popular platform for users looking for ideas and inspiration.

Pinterest's revenue for the quarter was driven by a 32% increase in advertising revenue, which rose to $666 million. The company's average revenue per user also increased, rising by 21% year-over-year to $1.67. However, the company's sales guidance for the current quarter was seen as disappointing, with revenue expected to be in the range of $770 million to $785 million, which is roughly in line with analyst estimates. The company's CEO, Bill Ready, stated that the company is focused on building a more personalized and shoppable experience for its users.

The reaction to the earnings report was mixed, with some investors expressing disappointment at the company's sales guidance. The company's shares fell by over 10% in after-hours trading, wiping out gains made earlier in the day. Analysts were also cautious in their assessment of the company's prospects, citing the competitive nature of the social media landscape. However, others noted that the company's user growth and revenue increase were positive signs, and that the company's investments in its advertising business were paying off.

The earnings report comes at a time of increased competition in the social media space, with companies such as Facebook and Instagram also vying for users' attention. Pinterest's focus on visual discovery and planning has made it a popular platform for users looking for ideas and inspiration, but the company faces challenges in converting these users into revenue. The company's ability to compete with other social media platforms will be an important factor in its future success. The company's international expansion and growth in new markets will also be key to its future prospects.

As Pinterest looks to the future, the company will need to continue to invest in its advertising business and build a more personalized and shoppable experience for its users. The company's ability to execute on its strategy and compete with other social media platforms will be closely watched by investors. The company's next earnings report will provide further insight into its progress and prospects, and will be an important indicator of its future success. With the social media landscape continuing to evolve, Pinterest will need to stay focused on its users and advertisers to remain competitive.

items.story:
Advanced Micro Devices, or AMD, reported a significant increase in revenue, with a 50% climb, driven largely by its data center business, which saw sales double over the same period last year. The company's data center unit is emerging as a key driver of growth, with sales up 107% compared to the previous year. This surge in data center sales is a notable development for AMD, as it seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing cloud computing market. The strong performance of its data center business is expected to continue, with the company forecasting further growth in the coming quarters.

The growth of AMD's data center business is a significant milestone for the company, which has been working to diversify its product offerings and reduce its dependence on the PC market. In recent years, AMD has made significant investments in its data center business, including the development of new server processors and the expansion of its sales and marketing efforts. The company's efforts appear to be paying off, with its data center sales growing rapidly and its market share increasing. The data center market is a key area of growth for the tech industry, with companies such as Amazon, Microsoft, and Google investing heavily in cloud infrastructure.

AMD's revenue growth was driven by strong sales of its EPYC server processors, which are used in data centers to power cloud computing workloads. The company reported that sales of its EPYC processors more than doubled over the same period last year, with revenue from the data center business reaching a record high. AMD's CEO stated that the company is seeing strong demand for its data center products, driven by the growing need for cloud computing infrastructure. The company also reported that its gross margin increased, driven by the strong sales of its high-margin data center products.

Despite the strong revenue growth, AMD's stock price fell, as investors appeared to be concerned about the company's ability to sustain its growth in the face of intense competition from rivals such as Intel. The stock market reaction was likely driven by concerns about the company's valuation, with some investors feeling that the stock price had gotten ahead of the company's fundamentals. However, analysts remain positive about AMD's prospects, citing the company's strong product lineup and growing presence in the data center market. The company's data center business is expected to continue to drive growth, with many analysts forecasting further increases in sales and revenue.

The growth of AMD's data center business is part of a broader trend in the tech industry, as companies increasingly invest in cloud computing infrastructure. The data center market is a key area of growth, with companies such as Amazon, Microsoft, and Google investing heavily in cloud infrastructure. AMD's success in the data center market is a significant development, as it highlights the company's ability to compete with rivals such as Intel. The company's growing presence in the data center market is also expected to drive growth in other areas of its business, such as its PC and graphics businesses.

As AMD looks to the future, the company is expected to continue to invest in its data center business, with a focus on developing new products and expanding its sales and marketing efforts. The company is also expected to face intense competition from rivals such as Intel, which is working to develop its own data center products. However, analysts remain positive about AMD's prospects, citing the company's strong product lineup and growing presence in the data center market. items.story:
Major oil companies have reported a combined profit of $93 billion, a significant increase amid the ongoing war and climate crisis, with Exxon alone making $160 million per day in the last quarter. This surge in profits is largely attributed to the rise in oil prices due to disruptions in global supply chains. The oil industry has been experiencing a boom in recent months, driven by high demand and limited supply. As a result, companies such as Exxon, Chevron, and ConocoPhillips have seen their profits soar to record levels.

The current situation is a culmination of various factors, including the conflict in Iran, which has led to a decrease in oil production and an increase in prices. Historically, oil companies have been criticized for prioritizing profits over environmental concerns and social responsibility. The climate crisis has also played a significant role in shaping the oil industry, with many countries imposing stricter regulations and transitioning to cleaner energy sources. Despite these challenges, oil companies have managed to maintain their profitability, largely due to their ability to adapt to changing market conditions.

According to recent financial reports, Exxon's daily profit of $160 million is a significant increase from previous quarters, with the company's total profit reaching $20 billion in the last quarter. Chevron and ConocoPhillips have also reported substantial profits, with Chevron making $12 billion and ConocoPhillips making $7 billion. These figures are a testament to the oil industry's resilience and ability to thrive in uncertain market conditions. Officials from these companies have attributed their success to effective management and strategic decision-making.

The news of record profits has sparked mixed reactions, with some stakeholders praising the companies' ability to navigate complex market conditions and others criticizing their prioritization of profits over social and environmental concerns. Many experts have expressed concerns that the high profits may not be sustainable in the long term, given the increasing demand for cleaner energy sources and the potential for stricter regulations. The public has also been affected by the high oil prices, with many consumers feeling the pinch of increased fuel costs. As a result, there is growing pressure on oil companies to invest in renewable energy sources and reduce their carbon footprint.

The current situation has significant implications for the global economy and the environment. The high oil prices have contributed to inflation and economic instability in many countries, while the increased demand for fossil fuels has exacerbated the climate crisis. Many countries are now investing heavily in renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, in an effort to reduce their dependence on fossil fuels. The oil industry is also facing increasing competition from electric vehicle manufacturers and other alternative energy sources. As a result, oil companies are being forced to adapt and diversify their operations to remain competitive.

As the oil industry continues to evolve, many questions remain about its future prospects and the potential impact on the environment. With the global demand for energy expected to increase in the coming years, oil companies will need to balance their pursuit of profits with the need to reduce their carbon footprint and invest in sustainable energy sources. The upcoming decisions by governments and regulatory bodies will play a crucial role in shaping the future of the oil industry, and it remains to be seen how companies will respond to the growing pressure to prioritize social and environmental concerns.

items.story:
Rep. Max Miller, a Republican from Ohio, announced on Tuesday that he will file paperwork for an ethics investigation into himself, following a series of allegations involving his ex-wife. The move comes as Miller faces domestic abuse allegations, which he has denied, and is seeking reelection in a competitive race. Miller, a former Trump aide, has been under scrutiny in recent days, with the allegations against him making headlines. He has maintained that he is innocent and has nothing to hide.

The allegations against Miller have sparked a heated debate, with many calling for him to drop out of the race. However, Miller has refused to do so, instead choosing to deny the allegations and seek an ethics investigation into himself. This development is significant, as it marks a rare instance of a politician calling for an investigation into their own actions. The investigation will likely shed more light on the allegations against Miller and provide a clearer picture of what actually happened.

According to Miller, he is looking forward to the investigation and is confident that it will clear his name. In a post on X, Miller stated that he has "absolutely nothing to hide" and is eager for his colleagues to review the evidence for themselves. The investigation will be conducted by the House Ethics Committee, which will review the allegations against Miller and determine whether he has violated any House rules. The committee's findings will be made public, providing a level of transparency and accountability in the process.

The reaction to Miller's announcement has been mixed, with some praising his decision to seek an investigation and others criticizing him for not dropping out of the race. Many have expressed concern about the allegations against Miller and have called for him to be held accountable if they are found to be true. The Ohio GOP has stood by Miller, with some officials expressing support for his decision to stay in the race. However, others have been more critical, arguing that Miller's actions are a distraction and that he should prioritize the well-being of his constituents.

The allegations against Miller have also sparked a wider conversation about domestic abuse and the need for greater accountability in politics. Many have argued that politicians should be held to a higher standard and that allegations of abuse should be taken seriously. The incident has also raised questions about the role of social media in politics, with some arguing that platforms like X can be used to spread misinformation and manipulate public opinion. As the investigation into Miller continues, it is likely that these issues will remain at the forefront of the conversation.

As the ethics investigation into Miller moves forward, it remains to be seen what the outcome will be and how it will impact his reelection campaign. Miller's decision to seek an investigation into himself has added a new layer of complexity to the situation, and it is unclear how voters will respond. One thing is certain, however: the allegations against Miller have sparked a critical conversation about accountability and transparency in politics, and the outcome of the investigation will be closely watched by many.

items.headline: Cyclosporiasis Cases Surge Nationally, Federal Health Agency Reports Widespread Outbreak Across Fifteen States
items.teaser: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has expanded its investigation into the largest known cyclosporiasis outbreak to 15 sta…
items.story:
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has expanded its investigation into the largest known cyclosporiasis outbreak to 15 states, with thousands of people falling ill and two reported deaths. The outbreak, which has been ongoing for several months, has affected a significant number of people across the country, prompting concerns about the spread of the disease. According to the CDC, cyclosporiasis is a parasitic infection caused by the Cyclospora cayetanensis parasite, which can be spread through contaminated food and water. The agency has been working to identify the source of the outbreak and prevent further spread of the disease.

Cyclosporiasis is a relatively rare disease in the United States, but outbreaks have occurred in the past, often linked to imported produce. The current outbreak is notable for its size and scope, with cases reported in multiple states across the country. The CDC has been monitoring the outbreak closely, working with state and local health authorities to investigate cases and identify potential sources of the parasite. The agency has also issued guidance to healthcare providers and the public on how to prevent and treat the disease.

According to the CDC, over 11,000 cases of cyclosporiasis have been reported in Michigan alone, with 15 states affected overall. The two reported deaths were in Michigan, marking the first known deaths linked to the ongoing outbreak. The CDC has not identified a specific source of the outbreak, but is working to determine whether the cases are linked to a common source, such as a food product or water source. The agency has also noted that the outbreak is ongoing, with new cases being reported regularly.

The outbreak has prompted concerns among public health officials and the general public, with many people seeking information on how to prevent and treat the disease. The CDC has advised people to take precautions when handling and consuming food, particularly imported produce, and to seek medical attention if they experience symptoms of the disease, such as diarrhea, abdominal cramps, and fatigue. The outbreak has also had an impact on the food industry, with some companies issuing recalls of potentially contaminated products.

The cyclosporiasis outbreak has broader implications for public health and food safety in the United States. The outbreak highlights the need for continued vigilance and monitoring of foodborne illnesses, as well as the importance of international cooperation to prevent the spread of diseases. The CDC is working with international partners to investigate the source of the outbreak and to develop strategies to prevent similar outbreaks in the future. The agency is also working to improve its surveillance and detection capabilities, to quickly identify and respond to emerging outbreaks.

As the investigation into the cyclosporiasis outbreak continues, the CDC is expected to provide updates on the number of cases and any new developments in the investigation. The agency may also issue additional guidance to healthcare providers and the public on how to prevent and treat the disease. In the coming weeks and months, it will be important to monitor the outbreak and to watch for any new developments, including potential sources of the parasite and any changes in the number of cases or reported deaths.

New CEO Silvio Napoli has been at the helm of the company since earlier this year, and this announcement marks a significant development in his tenure.

Lucid, which has been a notable player in the luxury electric vehicle segment, has faced challenges in scaling up its production to meet demand. The company's earlier production expectations were suspended by CEO Napoli, indicating a shift in strategy. This background of suspended production expectations and the highly competitive electric vehicle market provides context for the company's decision to delay its midsize vehicle.

Key details of the operational reset and the delayed midsize vehicle production are still emerging, but it is clear that the company is taking a step back to reassess its plans. The reaction to the announcement has been mixed, with some investors expressing concern about the delay and its potential impact on the company's growth prospects. The electric vehicle market is highly competitive, and any delay in bringing new products to market can have significant consequences. However, others have viewed the decision as a necessary step to ensure that the company gets its production plans right. The company's stock price has been volatile in recent months, and this announcement is likely to add to the uncertainty.

The wider context of the electric vehicle market suggests that companies are facing significant challenges in scaling up production and meeting demand. Several manufacturers have experienced production delays and setbacks, highlighting the complexity of bringing new electric vehicles to market. The delay of Lucid's midsize vehicle production is part of a broader trend in the industry, where companies are taking a more cautious approach to production planning. Regional and global implications of this trend are still emerging, but it is clear that the electric vehicle market will continue to evolve in the coming months.

As Lucid navigates its operational reset, the company will face several key decisions in the coming months. Investors and analysts will be watching closely to see how the company's production plans evolve and how it addresses the challenges in the electric vehicle market. The company's ability to execute on its plans and bring new products to market will be critical to its success. Grande's experience is not unique, as many female celebrities face similar scrutiny and criticism about their bodies and personal lives. The constant attention and commentary can take a toll on their mental health and self-esteem, leading some to speak out against the unfair standards and expectations placed upon them. Grande has been open about her struggles with anxiety and depression, and her decision to step back from the public eye is seen as a proactive step to prioritize her well-being. The reaction to Grande's decision has been largely supportive, with many fans and fellow celebrities expressing understanding and admiration for her courage in prioritizing her well-being. However, some have also expressed disappointment and concern about the impact of her decision on her career and public image. The incident has also sparked a wider conversation about the role of social media in perpetuating scrutiny and criticism, with some arguing that it has created a culture of constant commentary and judgment. As a result, there are calls for greater awareness and accountability around the impact of social media on mental health and well-being.

The incident highlights the broader issues surrounding celebrity culture and the impact of constant scrutiny on mental health and well-being. The constant attention and commentary can create a toxic environment that perpetuates unrealistic standards and expectations, leading to feelings of anxiety, depression, and low self-esteem. Grande's decision to step back from the public eye is a reminder that even high-profile celebrities are not immune to these pressures, and that it is essential to prioritize well-being and self-care. The incident also underscores the need for greater awareness and understanding around mental health and the impact of social media on well-being.

As Grande takes a break from the public eye, it remains to be seen how long she will be out of the spotlight and what the long-term impact will be on her career and public image. However, one thing is clear: her decision has sparked a necessary conversation about the importance of prioritizing well-being and self-care, particularly in the face of constant scrutiny and criticism. As the entertainment industry and society at large continue to grapple with these issues, it is likely that Grande's decision will be seen as a pivotal moment in the conversation around celebrity culture and mental health.

items.headline: FSSAI Cracks Down on Food Manufacturers Over Ambiguous Labels and Misleading Product Claims.
items.teaser: India's food regulator, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, has banned several products from Dabur India, including Dabur H…
items.story:
India's food regulator, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, has banned several products from Dabur India, including Dabur Honey and coconut milk, due to misleading labelling claims of being 100 per cent pure. The ban was imposed after the regulator found that such claims were in violation of the law and constituted false advertising. This move is expected to have significant implications for the company and the industry as a whole. The regulator's decision is aimed at protecting consumers from deceptive marketing practices.

The FSSAI has been cracking down on companies making false claims about their products, and this ban is the latest in a series of measures to ensure compliance with food safety and labelling regulations. Dabur India is a well-established company with a wide range of products, and the ban on its products is likely to affect its sales and reputation. The company has been ordered to withdraw the products from the market and rectify the labelling claims. The regulator's actions are part of a broader effort to improve food safety and transparency in India.

According to the FSSAI, the use of "100 per cent" claims on product labels is misleading and not supported by scientific evidence. The regulator has stated that such claims are in violation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, which requires companies to provide accurate and truthful information about their products. The FSSAI has also issued guidelines for companies to follow when making claims about their products, and has warned of strict action against those who fail to comply. The regulator's guidelines are aimed at ensuring that consumers have access to accurate information about the products they buy.

The ban on Dabur India's products has been met with mixed reactions from stakeholders, with some welcoming the move as a step towards improving food safety and transparency, while others have expressed concerns about the impact on the company's business. The ban is likely to affect not only Dabur India but also other companies that make similar claims about their products. Consumers are also likely to be affected, as they may need to look for alternative products that comply with the regulator's guidelines. The ban has sparked a debate about the need for stricter regulations and more effective enforcement to protect consumers.

The FSSAI's ban on Dabur India's products is part of a wider effort to improve food safety and transparency in India, and has implications for the food industry as a whole. The regulator's actions are likely to have a ripple effect on other companies that make similar claims about their products, and may lead to a more stringent regulatory environment. The ban also highlights the need for companies to be more transparent and honest in their marketing practices, and to provide accurate information to consumers. The regulator's efforts are aimed at building trust and confidence in the food industry.

The outcome of the ban on Dabur India's products is still uncertain, and it remains to be seen how the company will respond to the regulator's actions. The company may choose to appeal the ban or rectify the labelling claims to comply with the regulator's guidelines. The FSSAI is likely to continue to monitor the company's actions and ensure that it complies with the regulations. The regulator's decision is a significant development in the ongoing efforts to improve food safety and transparency in India, and is likely to have far-reaching implications for the food industry and consumers alike.

items.story: Photons traveling through a cloud of atoms can emerge so early that they appear to have spent a negative amount of time inside. Researchers tested whether this was merely a misleading feature of the light pulse by making extremely weak measurements of the atoms. Surprisingly, the atoms confirmed the same negative dwell time. The finding does not break standard physics, but it reveals that one of quantum mechanics’ strangest effects is physically measurable.

items.headline: Your brain may be wired to regain lost weight
items.teaser: Weight loss is not simply a test of willpower. The human brain evolved to protect body fat during times of scarcity, and it can treat a p…
items.story: Weight loss is not simply a test of willpower. The human brain evolved to protect body fat during times of scarcity, and it can treat a previously higher weight as the new normal, triggering stronger hunger, cravings, and lower energy use after weight loss. This biological “memory” helps explain why many people regain weight after dieting and why medications such as Wegovy and Mounjaro can help by reducing appetite signals, although their effects may fade when treatment ends.
